subject.title: Incomplete turn with tool call and payloads=0 is replayUnsafe and may poison session state

question: For replay-unsafe `tools>0`/`payloads=0` incomplete turns, should OpenClaw retry/fail over based on current-attempt side effects, persist a quarantine record and fail closed, or keep the current fail-closed warning behavior?
rationale: Automation cannot safely choose this policy because retrying can recover real cron/channel failures but may duplicate side-effectful tool work if the boundary is wrong.

options.title: Current-attempt safety plus diagnostics
options.body: Retry or fail over only when the current failed attempt has no committed side effects, and persist/log a clear quarantine outcome for unsafe attempts.

options.title: Fail closed with better diagnostics
options.body: Keep replay-unsafe turns non-retryable but improve cron/user diagnostics and operator guidance so the failure is diagnosable and recoverable.

options.title: Broad payload-empty retry
options.body: Retry all `tools>0`/`payloads=0` turns, accepting a higher duplicate-side-effect risk in exchange for faster recovery from provider flakes.

recommendation.title: Current-attempt safety plus diagnostics
recommendation.body: Retry or fail over only when the current failed attempt has no committed side effects, and persist/log a clear quarantine outcome for unsafe attempts.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the closest adjacent incomplete-turn recovery PRs and is the best visible routing candidate for the safety-policy choice.
